_meta.selection_rule: Take the need's own results (the entries of found.entries, not the ones tagged for all questions). Order them by (1) condition group as in results_by_need.json: at the oxygen and pressure of the environment; about one stated condition; without these conditions stated; other conditions; (2) result_kind: measured (or no label) before computed_by_authors, then simulation, then preliminary; (3) results of a PSI investigation of this catalogue (no 'relation') before results carrying 'relation' (related NASA experiment); (4) results with printed values before results without; (5) item id; ties keep the order of found.entries. Then walk the order and take a result unless two results of the same document are already taken (so at most two per document), until five are taken. If fewer than five exist after the rule, take what exists; the header says how many are shown.
_meta.line: The line is the item's team-worded text, whole and unchanged (no cut, whatever its length).
